title: Palaeoproteomic variation between cortical and trabecular bone
projectDescription: Here we provide proteomic datasets of  pairs of cortical and trabecular bone from six Early Holocene Caprinae rib fragments from the site of La Draga, Spain, using shotgun proteomics. Our observations on proteome size and protein, peptide, and amino acid degradation have implications for the sampling of archaeological skeletal remains  in highly degraded proteomic contexts, where preference should be given to the sampling of cortical bone in order to maximise the retrieval of larger and better-preserved skeletal proteomes.
sampleProcessingProtocol: Protein extraction was performed in accordance to (Jensen et al. 2023; https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jasrep.2023.104238 using homogenised bone powder from cortical and trabecular bone pairs from 6 rib specimens. A laboratory blank was added to measure laboratory and cross-sample contamination. Demineralisation was performed using UltraPure 0.5 M EDTA pH 8.0 (Invitrogen, Thermo Fisher Scientific) for 48 hours at room temperature under agitation. Digestion was performed with 0.8 µg/µl sequence grade Trypsin (Promega, V5111) for 18 hours at 37°C under mild agitation. After digestion the peptides were cleaned and desalted using EvoTip C18 tips (EvoSep, Odense, Denmark). LC-MS/MS was performed on a EvoSep One (EvoSep, Odense, Denmark), with the 60 samples-per-day (SPD) method with a 21 minute gradient, coupled to an Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) operating in data-dependent acquisition (DDA) mode.
dataProcessingProtocol: All .raw files generated were analysed on MaxQuant (version 2.1.3.0) and searched against the whole proteome of Capra hircus and Ovis aries (downloaded from UniProt.org on June 23rd 2023). The search was run in semi-specific Trypsin/P mode with oxidation (PM), deamidation (NQ), Gln (Q) -> pyro-Glu, and Glu (E) -> pyro-Glu as variable modifications. Other settings were set as default. The internal MaxQuant contamination list was used. Protein groups matching only to the internal contamination list, as well as any keratins, were excluded from further analyses.
